headline: Weathered Expanse Tops War Ledger as a Stonecradle Work Falls to Ruin
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has displaced Stlican Shelf at the head of the war's ledger of fire, logging sixty-five base actions in the day against Stlican's fifty-three, and the Colonial count there now stands at four works to five Warden. Stonecradle, where The Cord and Trammel Pool traded blows into the evening, shows four works apiece and one demolished — a ruin our last edition did not carry. Across all regions the ledger counts 284 Colonial works to 151 Warden. Stlican Shelf itself has gone quiet for better than three hours, its six Warden and three Colonial works unmoved, while Linn of Mercy has come alive again with three actions inside two hours, The Long Whine and Ulster Falls its busiest posts of the day. Farranac Coast's Transient Valley likewise stirs within the hour. Callahan's Passage has seen no change at The Latch in more than six hours, yet its daily losses near 6,700 Colonial and 5,640 Warden, the hourly pace better than doubled. The Dead Lands keeps its fifteen-hour silence even as its casualty rolls accelerate. It is day 218; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
